title: Stress relaxation of a Maxwell material
caption: Held at fixed strain, a Maxwell material's stress decays as σ = σ₀e^{−t/τ} with relaxation time τ = η/E = 1 s. After one τ the stress is 1/e = 0.368 of its starting value, after 3 τ only 0.050.
alt: Graph of stress divided by initial stress against time in seconds: an exponential decay falling to 0.368 at 1 second.
description: The horizontal axis is time in s after the strain is applied; the vertical axis is σ/σ₀.
τ = η/E = 10⁶ Pa s / 10⁶ Pa = 1 s.

checks.name: stress falls to 1/e after one relaxation time
0.050 of the stress is left after 3τ
